content_sections.body: Read the model aloud twice: 'I am going to apply for a part-time job after I finish my course.' Underline the words that show the situation, time, or result. In this lesson, describe a work or study plan using clear future language. Keep the language connected: do not give isolated words.
content_sections.title: Notice form and meaning (8 minutes)

content_sections.body: Partner A begins a realistic exchange about describing a work goal. Partner B asks for one missing detail. Swap roles and make one change to the time, place, reason, quantity, or next action. Check that the exchange achieves: Describe a work or study plan using clear future language.
content_sections.title: Guided dialogue (8 minutes)

content_sections.body: Create a short message about describing a work goal without reading the model. Include a main event or plan and one precise detail. Speak it once slowly, then once at a natural pace. Listen for whether the key information is clear.
content_sections.title: Independent response (6 minutes)
